queueItem: user report: the Agents window always shows 'The Agent Host failed to start'
question: why does it fail - we use OMP and it worked already?
answer: the banner is not about OMP. It is the base Agent Host utility process (the host for the Copilot/Claude/Codex harnesses) failing to boot because S1 removed the Copilot services its node-side graph still requires; the window started it at restore, so every launch produced a crash loop and the failure notification.

evidence.log: window1/main.log of a launch before the change
lines: [AgentHost:stderr] [createInstance] agentHostCustomizationEnablementService depends on copilotApiService which is NOT registered.
AgentHostProcessManager: agent host terminated with code 1, giving up after 5 restarts
AgentHostStarter: cannot create window connection: Agent Host process stopped after 5 restarts.
evidence.renderer: notifyOnFatalAgentHostStartError raises the text 'The Agent Host failed to start. Restart the application to try again.' (platform/agentHost/electron-browser/localAgentHostService.ts)
evidence.trigger: workbench/services/agentHost/electron-browser/agentHostService.ts: AgentHostPrewarmContribution autoruns on agentHostEnablementService.enabled (true in the Agents window because AI features are on) and calls startAgentHost()

change.patch: patches/desktop/0032-caret-no-base-agent-host.patch (two base files, neither owned by an earlier patch)
change.source: AgentHostPrewarmContribution no longer starts the host - the prewarmer class, the autorun, the assignment-context forwarding and their imports are removed; the contribution stays registered with a comment naming the process, the missing service and why Caret does not need it (OMP is the only execution owner)
change.test: the base suite for that contribution now pins the Caret contract: does not start the agent host while enabled / when enablement changes / does not forward assignment context
bookkeeping: patches/desktop/README.md: paragraph explaining why booting the process instead would mean re-adding the Copilot layer
apps/macos/test/ide-native-workbench.test.ts: needle test pinning the patch, the base-test contract and the removal of the startAgentHost() call

cd desktop && npm run typecheck-client: 0 errors (the unused prewarmer symbols had to go for this to pass)
bun run typecheck: clean; node scripts/ci-validate.mjs: CI-OK; check:cursor-parity: 340 keys, 0 mismatches
bun run test: 754 pass, 1 fail (menus-contract.test.ts needs rg on PATH; environmental)
verified.onScreenBefore: main.log carried the AgentHostProcessManager / AgentHost:stderr lines and the window showed the failure notification
verified.onScreenAfter: packaged app launched twice on the final revision: 0 agent-host lines in main.log, and a DOM + notification scan finds nothing matching /Agent Host|failed to start/i

notVerified: the Agent Host remains reachable if something ever asks it for work (the client and the singleton registration are untouched), so a future consumer would spawn the same crashing process; making that honest is follow-up work
the `Chat model provider uses UNKNOWN vendor caret-omp` startup line still appears in some launches; it predates this change and is the known race recorded in the S2 receipt
